title: Chapter 488 - 488 Return; Chance Encounter!
content:
Chapter 488 - 488 Return; Chance Encounter!

Chapter 488 - 488 Return; Chance Encounter!

488 Return; Chance Encounter!

After traveling for about an hour, the MJ yacht slowly stopped at Lin Fan’s request.

The staff of Flower Stem looked at each other and picked up their fishing rods again.

However, the atmosphere at the scene was not as lively as it was at the beginning.

Chu Yunyue did not have many other thoughts.

On the contrary, her eyes that were looking at Lin Fan shone even brighter.

Chu Yunyue had seen Lin Fan when he was focused on making perfume, and she had seen Lin Fan when he was singing…

However, she had never seen such a scene today. One sentence made everyone’s mouth twitch.

Domineering!

“Lin Fan, who were those people just now?” Chu Yunyue asked gently after a while.

Lin Fan shook his head and said, “I only know that the man with the gold-rimmed glasses is called He Xiong. He’s the chairman of Rising Sun Group.”

“Rising Sun Group?” Chu Yunyue was slightly shocked. “The world’s top 500…”

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes.”

Silence!

The entire MJ yacht was silent!

They all knew that Lin Fan had a lot of assets and a lot of wealth.

He was the largest shareholder of Xia Airlines, the largest shareholder of the Whitehorse Manor, and so on.

Even so, they were still shocked by Lin Fan’s words.

That was the chairman of Rising Sun Group!

Its market value was close to a trillion!

In the end, the chairman had to bow and greet Lin Fan.

Lin Fan did not care much. He looked at the grilled fish on the grill and said, “The fish is cooked.”

Then, the outstanding employees of Flower Stem gathered around.

Lin Fan picked up a glass of wine and said, “I wish us a happy trip to the Maldives. Cheers!”

“Thank you, Mr. Lin. Cheers!” Flower Stem’s employees raised their glasses.

After a glass of wine, the atmosphere became lively again.

Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, and the employees of Flower Stem spent a few more days at the Whitehorse Manor before they were sent off by Grians’ Rolls-Royce motorcade and boarded the private plane back.

When Lin Fan arrived at Jiangbei, it was already afternoon.

When Lin Fan drove the Cullinan past Xinyang Road, a beautiful figure caught his attention.

Peach blossom eyes, willowy eyebrows, cherry lips, and a full figure…

If it was not Su Ningjing, who could it be?

Speaking of which, he had not seen her for a long time.

Lin Fan turned the steering wheel and parked the Cullinan in a parking space by the roadside.

Then, he strode toward her.

Lin Fan was just about to open his mouth to greet her when Su Ningjing seemed to have sensed something and slowly turned her head.

In the next moment…

Her beautiful face was like a blooming flower, extremely brilliant.

“Lin Fan!”

A beautiful voice immediately came out of her cherry mouth.

“Did you just go grocery shopping?” Lin Fan looked at the groceries in her hands and asked.

As he spoke, he reached out to help carry the groceries.

“Yes, yes!” Su Ningjing nodded vigorously.

However, she stepped aside and said, “The bag is dirty. Let me carry it.”

Lin Fan took the lead and touched the mud in the bag. He smiled and said, “My hands are already dirty, so it doesn’t matter.”

Then, without waiting for Su Ningjing to say anything, he took the bag.

At this moment, a series of crisp footsteps sounded not far away.

A woman with a good figure and a cute bag hanging on her waist as well as a face that looked like a typical internet celebrity’s was holding a man in a white shirt as they walked over from afar.

When the woman saw Su Ningjing, her expression changed slightly as she said, “Huh, Su Ningjing?”

Su Ningjing heard this and looked over.

However, her pretty face revealed a doubtful expression as she asked, “And you are?”

“What? You don’t know me anymore after graduating?” The woman laughed. “I’m Wang Yunfang!”

Su Ningjing’s pretty face clearly revealed a hint of surprise.

She and Wang Yunfang were indeed classmates, university classmates.

However, in her memory, Wang Yunfang seemed to have a square face.

Why did she have an oval face now?

After a while, Su Ningjing said apologetically, “Sorry, I didn’t recognize you just now.”

“It’s okay, it’s okay.” Wang Yunfang waved her hand and said, “Su Ningjing, have you been staying in Jiangbei ever since you graduated from university? What are you doing now?”

Su Ning said quietly, “I worked at Ai Er Housekeeping previously. Now… I stay at home and take care of Grandma and Sister.”

When Wang Yunfang heard the words ‘Ai Er,’ she almost laughed out loud.

Was that not a cleaning company?

‘Su Ningjing, weren’t you the prettiest girl in the class?

‘Weren’t you very popular with our classmates?

‘What now?

‘You’re only a cleaner?’

However, Wang Yunfang still replied, “I see.”

Then, she seemed to have noticed Lin Fan standing beside her. “This is?”

“I’m Ningjing’s boyfriend, Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

Wang Yunfang could not help but look at Lin Fan. When she saw his tall and handsome appearance, a hint of jealousy flashed across her face.

However, when she saw the groceries in Lin Fan’s hands, a look of disdain flashed across her face.

She thought to herself, ‘What’s the use of being handsome? So what if she’s beautiful? One can only haggle in the market, while the other can only be a cleaner!’

Wang Yunfang said, “So you’re Su Ningjing’s boyfriend. Oh right, this is my fiance, Shu Jiadong.”

Shu Jiadong said, “Hello. Yunfang and I are getting married this Saturday. If you have time, you can come over and join in the celebration.”

Speaking of this…

The smile on Wang Yunfang’s face widened. She said, “Have you heard of the Imperial Hotel? That’s a landmark building in Jiangbei! It’s the most luxurious hotel in Jiangbei! My husband and I are having our wedding at the Imperial Hotel. It’s easy to find!

“If you really can’t find it, you can just take a taxi on the road.”

“Su Ningjing, Lin Fan, you must come over when the time comes!”

On the surface, she seemed to be talking about the place where she was getting married.

In fact, it was to show how luxurious her wedding venue was.

She was showing off!

Su Ningjing did not reply immediately. Instead, she looked at Lin Fan who was standing at the side.

She could go over.

However, she did not know if Lin Fan had the time.

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course! Saturday, right? We’ll be there.”

When Su Ningjing heard this, the smile on her pretty face became even wider.

This meant that she would be able to meet Lin Fan again on Saturday.

Therefore, Su Ningjing also said, “We’ll go over.”

“Alright!” Wang Yunfang nodded. “Then it’s a deal!”

At this moment, the phone in her pocket vibrated slightly.

She looked at her phone and said, “I still have something to do. I won’t chat with you guys anymore.”

After saying that, she held Shu Jiadong’s arm and continued walking forward.
